instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng

questions.question: Who developed COCOMO '81?
options: Thomas J. McCabe
Gordon B. Davis
Barry W. Boehm
Allan Albrecht
options_en: Thomas J. McCabe
Gordon B. Davis
Barry W. Boehm
Allan Albrecht
questions.explanation: Barry W. Boehm developed the original Constructive Cost Model.
questions.explanation_ar: طوّر Barry W. Boehm نموذج تقدير الكلفة الأصلي.

questions.question: Which phrase expands the COCOMO acronym?
options: Common Cost Estimation Model
Complete Cost Estimation Model
Comprehensive Cost Estimation Model
Constructive Cost Estimation Model
options_en: Common Cost Estimation Model
Complete Cost Estimation Model
Comprehensive Cost Estimation Model
Constructive Cost Estimation Model
questions.explanation: COCOMO means Constructive Cost Estimation Model and is also called the Constructive Cost Model.
questions.explanation_ar: يعني COCOMO نموذج تقدير الكلفة البنائي، ويُسمّى أيضاً Constructive Cost Model.

questions.question: Which equation gives Basic COCOMO effort in Organic mode?
questions.question_ar: أي معادلة تعطي جهد Basic COCOMO في النمط العضوي؟
questions.explanation: Basic COCOMO uses mode-specific coefficients; the Organic effort equation has coefficient 2.4 and exponent 1.05.
questions.explanation_ar: يستخدم Basic COCOMO معاملات خاصة بكل نمط؛ ومعادلة الجهد العضوي معاملها 2.4 وأُسها 1.05.

questions.question: A familiar, relatively flexible project is about 2–50 KLOC. Which mode is the typical match?
questions.question_ar: مشروع مألوف ومرن نسبياً حجمه نحو 2–50 KLOC؛ أي نمط يطابقه عادةً؟
options: Post-Architecture model after architecture
Organic mode for small familiar projects
Semidetached mode for medium mixed projects
Embedded mode for tightly constrained work
options_en: Post-Architecture model after architecture
Organic mode for small familiar projects
Semidetached mode for medium mixed projects
Embedded mode for tightly constrained work
options_ar: نموذج ما بعد المعمارية بعد استقرارها
questions.explanation: The Organic mode fits the typical 2–50 KLOC range and a familiar environment.
questions.explanation_ar: يناسب النمط العضوي المدى المعتاد 2–50 KLOC والبيئة المألوفة.

questions.question: How many effort multipliers does Intermediate COCOMO '81 use?
questions.question_ar: كم مضاعف جهد يستخدم COCOMO '81 المتوسط؟
options: Seventeen multipliers in four groups
Seven multipliers in three groups
Fifteen multipliers in four groups
Fourteen multipliers in five groups
options_en: Seventeen multipliers in four groups
Seven multipliers in three groups
Fifteen multipliers in four groups
Fourteen multipliers in five groups
options_ar: سبعة عشر مضاعفاً ضمن أربع فئات
خمسة عشر مضاعفاً ضمن أربع فئات
أربعة عشر مضاعفاً ضمن خمس فئات
questions.explanation: Intermediate COCOMO applies fifteen effort multipliers organized into four cost-driver categories.
questions.explanation_ar: يطبق COCOMO المتوسط خمسة عشر مضاعف جهد منظمة ضمن أربع فئات لعوامل الكلفة.

questions.question: How does Intermediate COCOMO adjust nominal effort?
questions.question_ar: كيف يعدّل COCOMO المتوسط الجهد الاسمي؟
options: Nominal effort plus the sum of all EMs
Project size times total schedule duration
Project size divided by the productivity index
Nominal effort times the product of all EMs
options_en: Nominal effort plus the sum of all EMs
Project size times total schedule duration
Project size divided by the productivity index
Nominal effort times the product of all EMs
options_ar: الجهد الاسمي مضافاً إليه مجموع كل EMs
حجم المشروع مضروباً في مدة الجدول
حجم المشروع مقسوماً على مؤشر الإنتاجية
الجهد الاسمي مضروباً في حاصل ضرب كل EMs
questions.explanation: The effort adjustment factor is the product of the rated multipliers and scales nominal effort.
questions.explanation_ar: معامل تعديل الجهد هو حاصل ضرب المضاعفات المقيمة ويضرب في الجهد الاسمي.

questions.question: If an effort multiplier is below 1.0, what happens to effort when other inputs stay fixed?
questions.question_ar: إذا كان مضاعف الجهد أقل من 1.0، ماذا يحدث للجهد مع ثبات بقية المدخلات؟
options: Adjusted effort falls below nominal effort
Adjusted effort rises above nominal effort
Schedule changes but effort stays fixed
The multiplier cancels the project size
options_en: Adjusted effort falls below nominal effort
Adjusted effort rises above nominal effort
Schedule changes but effort stays fixed
The multiplier cancels the project size
questions.explanation: A multiplier below one reduces the product of effort multipliers and therefore lowers adjusted effort.
questions.explanation_ar: يقلل المضاعف الأقل من واحد حاصل ضرب مضاعفات الجهد، فيخفض الجهد المعدّل.

questions.question: Which project condition most strongly points to Embedded mode?
questions.question_ar: أي ظرف للمشروع يشير بقوة إلى النمط المدمج؟
options: An early project with coarse effort estimates
Severe hardware and operating constraints
A small, experienced team in a familiar domain
A medium team with mixed skills and experience
options_en: An early project with coarse effort estimates
Severe hardware and operating constraints
A small, experienced team in a familiar domain
A medium team with mixed skills and experience
options_ar: فريق صغير متمرس في مجال مألوف
questions.explanation: Embedded mode fits software developed under tight hardware, operational, or regulatory constraints.
questions.explanation_ar: يناسب النمط المدمج برمجيات تُطوّر تحت قيود صارمة للأجهزة أو التشغيل أو اللوائح.

questions.question: What does Intermediate COCOMO add to the Basic model?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يضيف COCOMO المتوسط إلى النموذج الأساسي؟
options: Risk registers for project development phases
Detailed estimates for interface design work
Effort multipliers for project cost drivers
A separate function-point size measure
options_en: Risk registers for project development phases
Detailed estimates for interface design work
Effort multipliers for project cost drivers
A separate function-point size measure
questions.explanation: Basic COCOMO is size-and-mode based; Intermediate adds cost-driver multipliers to nominal effort.
questions.explanation_ar: يعتمد COCOMO الأساسي على الحجم والنمط؛ ويضيف المتوسط مضاعفات عوامل الكلفة إلى الجهد الاسمي.

questions.question: What is the defining addition in Detailed COCOMO?
questions.question_ar: ما الإضافة التي تميّز COCOMO المفصّل؟
options: All project drivers become one size value
Risk exposure replaces the effort estimate
The project schedule is removed from estimates
Cost-driver effects are distributed by phase
options_en: All project drivers become one size value
Risk exposure replaces the effort estimate
The project schedule is removed from estimates
Cost-driver effects are distributed by phase
options_ar: تصبح كل عوامل المشروع قيمة حجم واحدة
يحل التعرض للمخاطر محل تقدير الجهد
توزّع آثار عوامل الكلفة على المراحل
questions.explanation: Detailed COCOMO applies cost-driver effects across development phases rather than only once project-wide.
questions.explanation_ar: يطبّق COCOMO المفصّل آثار عوامل الكلفة عبر مراحل التطوير بدلاً من تطبيقها مرة واحدة للمشروع.

questions.question: What size unit enters the Basic COCOMO effort equation?
questions.question_ar: ما وحدة الحجم التي تدخل معادلة جهد Basic COCOMO؟
options: Thousands of delivered source lines
Count of user-visible software functions
Number of calendar months in the schedule
Total project expenditure in currency
options_en: Thousands of delivered source lines
Count of user-visible software functions
Number of calendar months in the schedule
Total project expenditure in currency
questions.explanation: The COCOMO '81 effort equations use KLOC, so a LOC estimate must be expressed in thousands.
questions.explanation_ar: تستخدم معادلات جهد COCOMO '81 وحدة KLOC، لذا يعبّر عن LOC بالآلاف.

questions.question: A prompt says programmer experience is low but names no experience driver. What is the sound interpretation?
questions.question_ar: ذكر السؤال انخفاض خبرة المبرمج من دون تحديد عامل الخبرة؛ ما التفسير السليم؟
options: Treat programmer experience as project size
Do not rate every experience driver as low
Set every experience driver to low
Replace all cost drivers with nominal
options_en: Treat programmer experience as project size
Do not rate every experience driver as low
Set every experience driver to low
Replace all cost drivers with nominal
options_ar: اعتبر الخبرة جزءاً من حجم النظام
لا تخفض عوامل الخبرة كلها دون تحديد
اخفض عوامل الخبرة كلها دون استثناء
questions.explanation: A generic experience phrase does not identify AEXP, LEXP, or VEXP, so multiplying all three low ratings is unjustified.
questions.explanation_ar: لا تحدد عبارة الخبرة العامة عوامل AEXP أو LEXP أو VEXP؛ لذلك لا يصح خفضها كلها تلقائياً.
